claim_scope: Paired wall torque/pattern-speed power continuation on the fully coupled finite 335 rg minidisk
does_not_establish: Nonexistence of a physical tidally interacting state, because overflow, a free inner accretion rate, and multidimensional tidal transport are not represented.
establishes: The disk-rate wall control is mesh supported, but depositing 25% of the differential pattern work makes the tidal band geometrically thick; the confined one-zone continuation is outside its declared validity regime before full power.
